svg.title: AI agent authentication and authorization: architecture
svg.desc: Browser to istio-ingress to the web BFF to agent-copilot. The read path (red) goes through the MCP gateway to mcp-inspect, the Istio waypoint and inspect-api, which lists pods and logs in prod. The privileged path (green) goes over A2A to agent-specialist, then through the MCP gateway to mcp-ops and ops-api, which patches deployments in prod. SPIRE issues each workload a JWT-SVID. At every agent and MCP hop the workload exchanges its token at Curity (RFC 8693).

g.text: ① alice signs in with OIDC + PKCE; Curity issues the user token (aud=agent-copilot)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: ② read path: each hop proves itself with its JWT-SVID and swaps its token at Curity (RFC 8693), narrowed to inspect:read

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: ③ privileged path: A2A to the specialist, which needs ops:write and an MFA step-up (acr=mfa)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: read path (red): inspect:read · privileged path (green): ops:write + acr=mfa step-up
